audience: Belgian businesses and accountants who keep their books and Peppol invoices in Scrada

useCases.title: Read the booked journal lines of a period
useCases.text: List the journals of the company, then read their booked lines for a period. Use the marker to read the next page until none is left.

useCases.title: Check the cash books and VAT periods
useCases.text: List the cash books, bank accounts and cash registers. Then list the VAT periods of the company.

useCases.title: Look up a Peppol participant and a delivery status
useCases.text: Search the Peppol network for a participant by scheme code and value. Then read the delivery status of an outbound Peppol document.

useCases.title: Work through unconfirmed inbound Peppol invoices
useCases.text: List the inbound Peppol documents not yet confirmed. Read one as UBL XML, then confirm it as processed.

useCases.title: Record a payment on a sales invoice
useCases.text: Read the send status of the invoice, then record a payment on it. Each call adds another payment, so check before you repeat one.
